rules: Use Amiri or Cairo Bold for Arabic Headings to evoke traditional elegance combined with modern clarity.
Use Cinzel Bold for English Headings to convey a premium, authoritative, and cinematic feel.
Use Roboto Mono for all financial figures (net worth, gold prices, transactions) to ensure tabular alignment and precision.
Use IBM Plex Sans Arabic for all body text to maintain high legibility across languages.
Containers must use generous padding (e.g., p-6) to let content breathe and enhance the premium feel.
Adopt a card-less or subtle 'elevated' (#1A1A24) flat aesthetic for dashboards to minimize clutter, separated by 1px solid borders (#2A2A3A).
Mobile layout must support dynamic RTL (Right-to-Left) switching when the app language is set to Arabic, and LTR for English.
Use safe area insets properly on iOS and Android to prevent clipping under notches or home indicators.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-black font-bold rounded-lg px-6 py-4 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(200,169,110,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-primary text-primary rounded-lg px-6 py-4

inputs.text_field: bg-elevated border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-4 text-white focus:border-primary

images.description: Animated gold crescent for the welcome screen to convey Islamic premium aesthetic.

icons.style: Clean, thin strokes (1.5px), minimal fill unless active.

motion_and_interactions.splash_screen: Crescent moon should smoothly scale up and glow using React Native Reanimated, with 'Developed by Ziad Sabry' fading in at the bottom.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slide-up for premium feel. Avoid jarring native screen pushes if they disrupt the flow.
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Slight scale down on press (active opacity 0.8) to give tactile feedback.
motion_and_interactions.charts: Animate line charts drawing from left to right (or right to left in RTL).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text against #0A0A0F and #111118 meets APCA contrast guidelines. Specifically, tertiary text should not fall below 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, list items) MUST include a testID attribute (e.g. testID='login-submit-button') for React Native testing.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo application. Use NativeWind or StyleSheet as preferred, but map the Tailwind-like tokens exactly to the provided colors.
App must default to the Dark theme. The Light theme palette is provided as a fallback.
Implement RTL strictly for Arabic using standard React Native I18nManager.
Ensure 'Developed by Ziad Sabry' is distinctly placed at the bottom of the splash screen, in an elegant, understated typography (e.g. caption scale).
For the AI chat advisor, style the chat bubbles with deep rich tones (elevated #1A1A24) rather than bright primary colors to maintain the luxury feel.
In the Investment and Gold tabs, use Roboto Mono exclusively for live prices and percent changes to emphasize precision.
Apply data-testid to UI primitives as instructed for test coverage (or testID for react-native specifically).
